summary: The WH-1000XM5 headphones are available for ₹19,989, a saving of ₹4,706 (19%) compared to the market reference of ₹24,695. The claimed 43% discount translates to a real saving of 19%.

voices.point: Noise cancellation divides opinions, some finding it excellent, others stating it barely works.
Out-of-the-box sound is often described as muddy and bass-heavy, requiring equalizer tuning.
Several users report poor build quality, with headphones snapping or appearing cheaply made.
Some find the headphones comfortable, while others experience them as heavy or too tight.
